font-size:0 is also an inline-block spacing hack: a descendant restoring a non-zero size does render, so its text is kept

```rust title="Rust"
use html_to_markdown_rs::convert;
use html_to_markdown_rs::ConversionOptions;

fn main() {
    let html = r#"<div style="font-size:0"><span style="font-size:14px">restored and visible</span></div>"#;
    let options: ConversionOptions = Default::default();
    let result = convert(html, Some(options.clone())).expect("call failed");
    println!("{:?}", result.content);
}
```
